document.abstract: In a previous tutorial article, we discussed quality control in a digital system. To maintain the best quality, a standard has been developed. It is called EDH, for Error Detection and Handling. The following tutorial describes this method of monitoring a digital system while it is being used for production and broadcast purposes.
